criteria.requirement: Add real shop.py low-stock CATALOG --threshold NONNEGATIVE_INT --output NEW_CSV. Validate catalog first, include quantity zero and exact threshold, stable ascending quantity order with original-order ties. CSV header sku/name/quantity always present including empty selection; Unicode, commas, quotes and multiline names preserve csv roundtrip. Publish new report with exclusive atomic output helper, preserve input bytes and existing reports, reject negative threshold/bad catalog. Print selected count/total selected quantity/threshold only after success. Keep all prior inventory/product/export commands and fixed Typer unchanged; report is a real generated application artifact, not advice or documentation.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
